content.short: Kotani Pay connects Web3 users and businesses to local currencies across Africa.
content.description: Kotani Pay is a gateway between stablecoins and African local currencies, offering businesses stablecoin settlement and liquidity, plus APIs that let wallets and dApps add cash-in and cash-out in African markets. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Kotani Pay.
content.meta: Kotani Pay provides stablecoin on/off-ramps and settlement across Africa, listed on Stable.
